en.title: Tencent Hunyuan3D-2.1 Interactive 3D Generation Demo
en.hook: Tencent's interactive Hunyuan3D 2.1 demo for fast, high-fidelity 3D asset generation from text and image prompts.

Interactive web inference powered by the Gradio SDK
Improved geometric accuracy and rendering quality compared to previous versions
